Low salt RB (2 L)

37.28 g KCl  
20 mL 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5  
4 mL 0.5 M EDTA  
2 mL DTT

| DNA | 38 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| T4 PNK Reaction Buffer (10X) | 5 µl |
| ATP (10 mM) | 5 uL |
| [T4 PNK](https://www.neb.com/en-gb/products/m0201-t4-polynucleotide-kinase) | 2 µl (20 units) |
| Nuclease-free Water | up to 50 µl  |

Incubate 37 C, 40 mins. Deactivate 65 C, 20 mins. Clean up with a MinElute column, quantify and then use to set up O/N ligation.
